rows.notes: 4.4523 ms/token is the reciprocal of the measured 224.605 tokens/s median. The paired 1.504x statistic is the median of per-round ratios and need not equal the ratio of independent medians. The published case ran the published WebLLM runtime bundle and the published subgroup-32 model library with the one-step sampler. The entry pins runtime bundle 483b1aba; this run served the overlap bundle d36ca3f7 with batch pass, submit cadence and bind-group cache all off, since the pinned build was not on disk. The overlap patches are flag-gated and default off.

publishedSubgroup32Quiet.notes: Last quiet direct timing before the background load.

publishedSubgroup32UnderLoad.notes: Paired six-round published runtime and subgroup-32 baseline under sustained background CPU load.

caveat: Absolute measured throughput was taken while unrelated work saturated the CPU. The paired ratio is the robust headline; quiet numbers remain a projection until directly rerun.
